Counts of reply sentences that are preface (sentences before the location line), contents (description of the saved record's contents), offers (options or offers of further work), recital (an account of what was read, checked or done, other than the standing and number-check sentences the skill asks for) and assurance (claims about the result's quality or completeness), recorded in the note as preface/contents/offers/recital/assurance; pass when all five are 0.
